description: A plugin release, signed into the PUBLISHER'S OWN repo. The record is the trust anchor an install verifies against: its `cid` is the bundle, and its `artifact.sha256` the code the publisher published. A registry catalog (ing.lexicon.registry.manifest) is untrusted; the install proves this record is in the publisher's signed commit — and the bytes hash to `artifact.sha256` — before anything runs (@eoa/repo `verifyRelease`, bean blf2).

main.description: One published release. Keyed by tid so a publisher's release history is a set of records, not a mutable 'latest'.

plugin.description: The plugin's NSID, matching its ing.lexicon.plugin.manifest.

cid.description: The bundle CID this release names.

artifact.description: The published bytes: their checksum, and (optionally) size and fetch URL.

sha256.description: base64url(sha256(bytes)) — the same encoding @eoa/repo's verifyRelease computes.
